blocking.section: M1 exit criteria (7); M2 exit criteria (6); M3 exit criteria (6); M4 exit criteria (4)
blocking.issue: Newly identified. The Open-question clauses in the exit criteria contradict the owning documents, so a contributor who checks exit readiness works from wrong lists. M2 gives the wrong count. M3 and M4 each omit a question whose Blocking column names that milestone. M1 and M2 count only the questions that name the milestone, so they leave out questions that block a milestone feature by name. M3 uses the feature-based rule, so the milestones are inconsistent.
blocking.evidence: M2 criterion 6: "Every Open question whose Blocking column names M2 is closed, 41 at this snapshot". The sources hold 45 such rows, including OQ-security-and-identity-26, -27, -30 and -31 ("Yes, Planned (M2)") and OQ-deployment-topologies-19 ("Yes, for the Planned (M2) CRD source"). M3 criterion 6 omits Deployment topologies line 577: "OQ-deployment-topologies-13 | Which port serves the CRD conversion webhook ... | Yes, before `ruralz.io/v1beta1`, Planned (M3)". M4 criterion 4 omits line 581: "OQ-deployment-topologies-17 | What do Nodes do when every relay in their Region is lost? ... | Yes, for Planned (M4)", and also omits OQ-system-overview-16 ("Yes, for multi-region"). Feature blockers the M1 and M2 counts miss: OQ-security-and-identity-2 and -15 ("Yes, for `auth.basic`"), OQ-security-and-identity-3 ("Yes, for `auth.mtls`"), OQ-tech-stack-and-libraries-24 ("Yes, for `authz.geoip`"), OQ-security-and-identity-10 ("Yes, for `vault`"), OQ-security-and-identity-28 ("Yes, for `auth.upstream-sigv4`").
blocking.fix: Change '41' to '45' in M2 criterion 6. Add OQ-deployment-topologies-13 to M3 criterion 6. Add OQ-deployment-topologies-17 and OQ-system-overview-16 to M4 criterion 4. Rephrase M1 criterion 7 and M2 criterion 6 on the M3 model, for example 'Every Open question blocking an M1 feature is closed: the 30 whose Blocking column names M1, plus OQ-configuration-model-8 and OQ-security-and-identity-2, -3 and -15 (`auth.basic`, `auth.mtls`)'. For M2, add OQ-tech-stack-and-libraries-24, OQ-security-and-identity-10 and -28 in the same way.
